newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRENCH FINALISTS RACE TO GET KEY PLAYERS FIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH FINALISTS RACE TO GET KEY PLAYERS FIT.

text.p: French Cup finalists Guingamp and Nice are both in a race against the clock to get key players fit for their Parc des Princes showdown on Saturday.
Playmaker Stephane Carnot, without whom small town club Guingamp might not have reached their first ever final, has missed the last two league games with a strained thigh muscle.

Carnot, who has scored two goals in Guingamp's cup run, is wary of the fact that when he suffered a similar injury before the club's promotion two years ago he was out of action for two months. Guingamp also have striker Jerome Foulon nursing a pulled muscle.
Twice winners Nice have been putting their Liberian international striker James Debbah through an intense fitness programme.

Debbah has missed five league matches and the cup semifinal since damaging his left eye during the quarter-final win over fourth division Creteil in March when he scored his second goal of the competition.
